summary: Fixed the billing package against the docs: leap-year February and anchor-based period starts, inclusive used days, tier selection by minimum (including string minimums), order discount ordering and largest-remainder allocation, discount amounts in the order currency's exponent, exact (Fraction) rounding, invoice-mode tax rounding once per group, credit request atomicity and strict input validation. All 82 unit tests pass and tools/reconcile.py reports no disagreements.
